title: cadintent core topology
description: Node / edge / network are core object categories, optional per object kind. Core edges are undirected; flow direction is pack vocabulary. The kernel's one topology guarantee is referential integrity. Spec version 0.1.0.

NodeBinding.description: An edge end bound to a node.

TapBinding.description: An edge end bound to another edge mid-span (a tap: wye / inserta-tee). 'position' is the distance along the tapped edge's plan geometry from its end_a, a coordinate-quantum decimal string in SI metres. The tapped edge stays one object; the kernel enforces only that it exists.

EndBinding.description: What one edge end binds to: a node, or another edge at a position along it.

EdgeEnds.description: An edge's two distinguished, neutrally named ends. Per-end facts key off a and b; the binding carries no direction.

NetworkMembership.description: Network membership as a fact on the member: a list of network ULIDs (usually one; an object serving two systems belongs to both). The kernel enforces that referenced networks exist.
